class: §11.4.50 deterministic-consistency / §6.I clause 7 — flaky test discovered during full-suite execution
cycle: §6.L 67th invocation — full JVM unit-test suite execution
confirmed_fact: `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --continue` across all modules reported exactly ONE failure: `CredentialsViewModelTest > select provider updates selectedProvider` (feature/credentials) — '6 tests completed, 1 failed'. An isolated re-run `./gradlew :feature:credentials:testDebugUnitTest --tests lava.feature.credentials.CredentialsViewModelTest --rerun-tasks` PASSED 6/6 (test-results XML: tests=6 failures=0). The test is therefore FLAKY: it fails in the full-suite context and passes in isolation. Per §11.4.50 and §6.I clause 7, intermittent green is constitutionally indistinguishable from intermittent red — a flaky test is a real defect, not noise.
root_cause_hypothesis: STRONG HYPOTHESIS (reasoned from reading the production code; not yet proven by N-run instrumentation — per §11.4.6 marked as hypothesis, not asserted as fact): the test asserts a FIXED count of orbit-test awaitState() calls — runOnCreate() then awaitState() x2 (onCreate's load()) then SelectProvider then awaitState() x1. The production `CredentialsViewModel.load()` does `credentialManager.observeAll().first()` — a Room `Flow` `.first()`, collected on Room's own background executor, NOT the `runTest` virtual test dispatcher. onCreate's load() therefore resumes on real wall-clock thread timing the virtual dispatcher cannot control; under full-suite CPU load the interleaving of load()'s state emissions vs. the SelectProvider intent shifts, so the fixed awaitState() count lands on a state captured before SelectProvider's reduce (selectedProvider still null). The other 5 tests in the class are less sensitive — they await a side effect or assert on a re-load that re-settles state.
feature_impact: This is a TEST-determinism defect, NOT a broken feature. The SelectProvider action itself works — the isolated 6/6 pass confirms the production behavior is correct. No end-user-facing bug.
scope: Pre-existing. feature/credentials/src/test/kotlin/lava/feature/credentials/CredentialsViewModelTest.kt — unrelated to the codegraph incorporation that is this session's primary work; NOT introduced by it.
remediation_owed: Make `select provider updates selectedProvider` deterministic — drive orbit-test to the post-SelectProvider state robustly (await states until selectedProvider == 'rutracker' with a bounded iteration cap) instead of assuming a fixed awaitState() count; OR collect the Room Flow onto the test dispatcher in setUp() so onCreate's load() is fully virtual-time-controlled.
Confirm the root cause with N-run instrumentation BEFORE the fix (§6.T.1 reproduction-before-fix), then verify the fix per §11.4.50 — N=10 identical PASS runs in the full-suite context.

Tracked as a focused follow-up — deliberately NOT closed with a rushed awaitState() tweak in this 67th cycle: a change that merely hides the race rather than fixing the determinism would itself be a §6.J bluff. Honest discovery + honest record is the 67th-cycle deliverable for this finding.
constitutional_refs: §6.I clause 7 — flakiness must be diagnosed and fixed, not tolerated
§11.4.6 — no-guessing: the flakiness is CONFIRMED; the root cause is a marked hypothesis pending instrumentation
